question: Which divine forms are invoked to protect the forehead in this armor?
premises: The forehead is the target of protection.
Kumārī is invoked to protect it.
Kumārikā, described as visarga-devoid, is also invoked.
inference: Kumārī and the visarga-devoid Kumārikā are invoked to protect the forehead.
plain_english: May Kumārī protect the forehead, and may the visarga-devoid Kumārikā also protect it.
